meaning: Formal fact, from no premises: in every motion model the strong-reading prima via premises yield a first mover moved by none. Proved by instantiating the verified prima via theorem (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-PRIMA-VIA) at each model; a fact about the encoded premises, not about the source.
